metadata.title: Clicked like a confused chicken and somehow got 2 kills? Valorant, chill!
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was just bored and boom, 2 kills dropped.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question reality.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies when you least expect it.
Tap if your aim gave up but you still got kills!

Tap if your best kills were total accidents too!

#valorant #luckykill #funnygaming #gamingfails #shorts
